name: Gasthof Geierwallihof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Geierwallihof is situated in the Kaunertal valley in the village of Feichten. The setting is framed by the striking alpine scenery of the Tyrolean Oberland. From here, visitors enjoy direct access to the scenic hiking trails of Kaunertal and the nearby glacier ski area. The property is run as a traditional, family-operated inn. The guest room decor embraces alpine style while providing modern comfort. In the hotel restaurant, delectable regional cuisine is served. A wellness area with a sauna and steam bath is available for guests to relax. The Gasthof Geierwallihof is an ideal choice for active holidaymakers exploring Kaunertal.
